BLUE IS OFFICIALLY OUT IN THE WORLD 💙

We’ve played this countless times to thousands of you, so we’re absolutely buzzing to finally give it to you. Please like, comment and share it to every corner you can!

Today marks blue Monday, one of the hardest days in the calendar: yes it’s cold; yes it’s miserable out there, and yes there’s a lot of year ahead. But please, if you’re struggling, don’t bottle it. Reach out to those around you, it’s a lot easier with them than on your own.

We love you so much, and hope this tune can add some sunshine to the scariest month of the year, here’s to a MASSIVE 2026💙™️ | The Mercians | Facebook
